method: Read complete source text in nontruncated tool outputs; ranges are inclusive physical source lines. Structural searches are supplemental, not full-read evidence.

notes: Full FastCGI responder: params bounded to 65535 bytes, configured-param suppression and duplicate HTTP header joining (Cookie semicolon), 32KiB STDIN record splitting/padding and streaming shadow ownership. Version/type/request-ID1 validation, split-header joining across records, bounded large STDERR recycling/catch patterns, Content-Length completeness and END_REQUEST exact-boundary keepalive. Native cache/store/buffering/request streaming and PATH_INFO regex variables; keep_conn default off.

Complete gRPC HTTP/2 transport: always unbuffered request/response, trailers and early hints enabled, hop header suppression, static HPACK/Huffman and bounded header decoding, DATA and dual flow-control windows, SETTINGS/PING quotas, GOAWAY/RST parsing. Connection-pool cleanup owns persistent window data; sequential reuse adds stream ID 2, no concurrent multiplexing. Native grpcs TLS configuration, SNI/verification opt-in defaults, certificate cache and ALPN h2. grpc-status remains protocol trailer data, not an automatic application-level retry signal.
GET/HEAD only; escaped memcached key; strict VALUE key/length and END validation, 404 for missing key; nonbuffered body and protocol keepalive only after complete END.

HTTP/1 request URI/header/body assembly, correct streamed chunk framing, status/header/trailer parsers, Content-Length/body completeness/reuse guards, redirects/cookie rewrites, cache and TLS configuration. This commit defaults proxy_http_version to 1.1 and can dispatch version 2.

HTTP/2 upstream: one request context per connection lease; sequential keepalive reuse increments odd stream ID, rejects foreign streams. HPACK static table/Huffman with dynamic table disabled, bounded header budget, frame/flow-control/padding/window validation, control frame quotas, trailers/103, GOAWAY/RST, buffered/nonbuffered filters. No concurrent upstream multiplexing in this implementation.

SCGI netstring with CONTENT_LENGTH first, NUL-delimited compiled params; configured HTTP param suppression, combined duplicate headers with Cookie semicolon. Raw body chain, known-length unbuffered uploads only; HTTP status-line or CGI Status/Location fallback parsing, 101 upgrade support, common Content-Length filters/cache/store/buffering and retries. No protocol keepalive confirmation in this adapter.

Native key hash compatible with Cache::Memcached; consistent ring with 160 points per weight compatible with Cache::Memcached::Fast; binary ring lookup, RR within selected server, configuration-generation guard.
IPv4 first three bytes / all sixteen IPv6 bytes; weighted hash; bounded attempts before RR fallback; configuration-generation guard and shared eligibility rules.

Balancer runs before cache lookup; sockaddr match plus configuration tag in local mode. Explicit-upstream defaults: 32 local cache entries, one-hour max age, 60-second idle timeout, 1000 requests. Full request-body send, protocol keepalive and healthy events required; LRU cache/free queues; TLS closure may be asynchronous.
Weighted least connections via cross multiplication, smooth RR tie break, shared eligibility rules and backup handling.

Native header/last-byte modes plus optional inflight measurements; EMA five percent new, 20ms clusters, five-second cap, aged slow-peer credit, weighted estimated completion time; successful attempts only.
Weighted ranges with binary search; random two uses weighted least-connections comparison; bounded attempts before RR fallback; ranges rebuilt on generation change.

Native cookie/route/learn modes; shared session and expiry trees, MD5 session key, SID hint wrapper, default learned-session lifetime ten minutes, designated expiry worker. Initial large output was truncated in the middle; physical lines 601 through 1000 were reread completely to close the gap.

Shared slab peer copies, configuration generation, refs/zombie lifecycle, DNS/SRV timers and priority backups; pre-resolution reuses addresses from the old zone; non-NXDOMAIN temporary DNS failure retains current peers.

uWSGI four-byte packet prefix, uint16 little-endian key/value lengths and 65535 total params limit, modifier bounds 0..255, optional uwsgi_string; compiled params and duplicate header joining. Known-length streaming uploads, HTTP/CGI status parsing and upgrade, generic body/cache/store/retry paths. suwsgi TLS/SNI/verification/client certificates/cache supported; TLS verification/SNI default off for compatibility. No protocol keepalive confirmation in this adapter.

Native shared slab/rbtree/LRU metadata and MD5 filename plus CRC32/full-key collision check; cache format version 5, Vary variant keys, lock age/timeout with 500ms event polling, loader/manager file/time/sleep budgets and min-free/max-size bounds. Complete-response temporary-file rename; inode/size/header guard on 304 update; deletion outside shared mutex with count/deleting guards; cleanup releases updating only for matching lock generation.

Full lifecycle: create/init/cache/DNS/connect/TLS/send/header/early hints/body/upgrade/retry/finalize. POST/LOCK/PATCH after request_sent require NON_IDEMPOTENT; sent unbuffered body cannot retry; retry budget is tries plus timeout; 403/404 use PEER_NEXT rather than passive failure. Response duplicate CL and CL+TE rejected; TE only chunked. Nonbuffered chains/backpressure versus event-pipe buffers/temp files/cache/store; committed headers cannot be replaced by a new status. Cache stale/revalidate/background controls, cookie/Vary exclusions, cleanup and statistics variables.

Smooth weighted RR uses configured/current/effective weights; failure reduces effective weight, which recovers one per eligible selection. Single-peer path bypasses max_fails suppression but checks down/max_conns. Per-request tried bitset, backup fallback, configuration-generation guard, refs/zombie lifecycle and shared SSL-session copy.

summary.runtime_validation: No C implementation changes or new NGINX runtime/protocol benchmarks performed in this read-only review.

scope_limits: Complete textual reading covers only the assigned manifest, not every transitive function or build configuration.
Full reading is not formal verification, exhaustive branch coverage, a security certification, or a throughput result.
Conditional code was read as source; platform/feature-specific build execution is not implied.
